name: Chromabelt
summary:
Chromabelt is a color-matching puzzle game. The player launches chameleon shooters onto a conveyor belt that runs around a pixel-art picture, and each chameleon clears the pixels of its own color as it passes. Every chameleon carries exactly enough ammo, so the order of launches is the puzzle; bonded chameleons, a five-slot dock, color-locked blocks, keys, snakes and painters appear in later levels.

The game has 2,000 pictures in eighty galleries, a daily board, a Hot Streak mode, a Belt Rally race and a gallery of every finished picture.
